essence: The characteristics of these mudrās are stated according to the order in which they were mentioned.
Placing the two thumbs forms the mudrā traditionally known as āvāhanī.
The sannidhāpanī mudrā is formed by joining two fists that have raised thumbs.
A pair of upturned fists is considered the sammukhīkaraṇī mudrā.
The avaguṇṭhana mudrā is defined as this gesture rotated all around.
